examples.text: Я серьёзно, ну сам посуди.
examples.trans: I am serious, just judge for yourself.

examples.text: Честно говоря, я сам не знаю почему.
examples.trans: Honestly, I do not know why myself.

examples.text: Дальше действуешь сам, выше нос!
examples.trans: From there you act on your own, chin up!

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'судить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'judge for yourself'.

related.gloss: not to judge for yourself (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Я серьёзно, ну сам посуди.
examples.trans: I am serious, just judge for yourself.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и посудить вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and judge for yourself on time.
